programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Haqdaar
programme.desc: Sakthivel, an influential man, is upset with his son Chinnarasu's careless attitude. He is further infuriated when Chinnarasu suddenly refuses to marry his cousin, Gowri.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Ishq Ki Aag
programme.desc: Priyanka, a rich and studious girl, despises Raghu, a student in her college. Problems arise when she develops feelings for him but he falls in love with Aarthi, his classmate.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Pataakha
programme.desc: Badki and Chhutki are two sisters who constantly keep fighting with one another. However, when they get married, they understand each other's importance and build a stronger bond.

programme.title: Sikka
